title: Page 10
lines: 她闭了下眼，想打起精神却觉得更加疲累，如今她的情况不单帮不上忙，更会拖延正事。
“我没事……”她忍着喉咙不适，硬是挤出沙哑难听的声音，“你去忙吧。”
她原以为他会将她放下，头也不回的离去，不料他不单没放下她，环在她腰上的手反而紧了紧。
她的心一颤，抬起头看他，在他眼中看到担心，却有更多的脆弱与恐惧，她从未见过他怯懦，突然有想哭的冲动，手覆在他的手上，“对不起。”
他低下头将头埋在她的颈间，姥爷的死让他发现了自己深埋在心中害怕失去的恐惧，这份恐惧是他的软肋，而他下意识的想逃。
赵小丫成了他最想留在身旁，却也最想远离的一个。
他真的怕，当他看到卧倒在马车里一动也不动的她时，要失去她的恐惧揪住他的心。
赵小丫感受到周屹天的身子微微颤抖，他温热的泪水浸湿了她的颈项，她的心像被针刺了一下又一下，隐隐作痛，静静的任由他无声哭泣。
她知道不论前世今生，因为自尊，他的脆弱只会在她的面前显现。
她不知道上辈子他如何独自一人走过失亲的痛楚，但如今有她陪着。
她的眼睛闪烁着泪光，原本枯萎的心重燃希冀。
纵使上天冥冥之中注定了结局，为了他，她也会好好活下去，无惧无畏。
第十章 暗夜袭击(2)
周屹天将顾乔成葬在京郊的庄子，他姥姥的墓旁。
这个不大的庄子原是顾家老宅，顾乔成在闺女成亲时将庄子当成嫁妆陪嫁进入侯府，只是在她死后，周堂尧将顾家的嫁妆如数归还。
顾乔成入土为安那日，赵小丫被包得密不通风，只露出一双眼睛，倚着周屹天，坚持全了礼数。
回来之后她果然开始发烧，周屹天又折腾了大夫一番，一直到她退了烧，身子好了些才让人回去。
赵小丫看着窗外，黑沉沉的一片，似乎有降下大雪之势。
这个庄子占地不大，就是个三进房舍，却是顾乔成一生的心血。
赵小丫轻抚着窗棂，原本的漆已褪，看来不再如初时新颖，用的却是上等木材，可见顾乔成当年是用了大心思。
“姑娘，你身子还未大好，别站在窗前，以免受了寒气。”说话的是送药过来的庄子管事夏嬷嬷。
她的身后跟着一个跟赵小丫差不多年纪的姑娘杏儿，是她的外孙女。
当年闺女刚死女婿就急着迎新人，夏嬷嬷舍不得还在吃奶的小娃子，便将人带回庄子，将小姑娘养到了十六岁，已经定了亲。
赵小丫听话的离开窗前，坐到了榻上，接过夏嬷嬷手上的药，眉头也不皱的喝了药。
她的身子其实已经好了许多，只是周屹天不放心，要不是看她真的受不了，他还打算让她一直躺在床上不要起来。
周屹天的上心弄得庄子上下都把眼珠子盯在赵小丫身上，赵小丫着实不习惯。
夏嬷嬷慈祥的看着她，还给她备了糖。
赵小丫拿了颗糖塞进嘴里，忍不住一笑，觉得自己越活越回去，像个孩子似的。
“今日姑娘的脸色倒是好了许多。”夏嬷嬷说道。
庄子里的奴才加起来二十余人，都是当时顾家的老奴，顾乔成离京时就已交代，顾家的一切都属于周屹天，所以这么些年，奴才们也视周屹天为主子。
“都是嬷嬷费心。”赵小丫从周岳口中得知，这位夏嬷嬷从小就在顾府当差，很受顾乔成信任，所以心中对她多了几分亲近。
“老奴不敢。”夏嬷嬷看着赵小丫的笑容，也忍不住扬了嘴角。
周屹天在十岁犯事，被周堂尧以闭门思过为由送到庄子，这些年起居就在庄内。
他对庄子的事并不上心，年纪不小，侯府没提及他的亲事，夏嬷嬷一个老婆子急在心里，但也毫无办法。
没料到周屹天好不容易终于带回一个姑娘，却同时带回了顾乔成的棺槨，她这心悲喜交杂，几日无法好好睡一觉。
她从举止可以看出这个姑娘虽温和良善，但出身不高，这样的身分她私心不认为配得上周屹天，但是一听是顾乔成看中之人，她心中那点觉得不配的心思就烟消云散。
主子看人的目光向来准确，若是他看中，肯定是个不错的姑娘，至于举止进退，慢慢学便是了。
夏嬷嬷看了眼身后的杏儿，杏儿立刻上前将手上的帐册全都放在桌上。
赵小丫不由得挑了下眉。
“爷交代老奴交给姑娘过目。”
赵小丫知道这是要让她管家之意，她虽然识字，但从没管过家。
她伸出手翻了翻，发现夏嬷嬷能力不俗，将庄子打点得极好，送上来的帐本也写得一淸二楚。
她有不懂的便问，夏嬷嬷没有一丝轻慢，仔细的交代。
赵小丫学东西向来快，夏嬷嬷不禁真心的又高看了她几分。
“姑娘，歇会吧。”夏嬷嬷对专心的赵小丫说：“这帐也不是一天就能看完的。”
赵小丫这才注意到时光流逝，外头降下了大雪，她合上帐册。
杏儿立刻上前收拾。
赵小丫挺喜欢这个机灵的姑娘，周屹天的意思便是让她将杏儿带在身边。
她自小就是伺候人的，从没有想过有一日会被人伺候，本想拒绝，但目光一对上周屹天的疲累憔悴，她便不拿这等小事烦扰他。
“姑娘，有一事老奴不知当说不当说……”
赵小丫直视着夏嬷嬷，微微笑道：“嬷嬷请说。”
夏嬷嬷心下迟疑，想着这是个比杏儿还小的孩子，最后她摇了摇头，“无事，就是天冷，姑娘多喝热茶，身子好得快些。”
“谢嬷嬷，我知道。”
看着赵小丫天真的样子，夏嬷嬷心中无奈，之前赵小丫病了，被周屹天安排住进正院自己的房里，她虽觉不妥，但看周屹天上心，她也不好多言。
如今人既大好，自然该移居他处。与其说她顾念周屹天名声，倒不如说是顾念赵小丫，这无名无分的，还没成亲，分际若拿捏不好，总是赵小丫吃亏。
看周屹天的态度是视礼教于无物，但相处几日，夏嬷嬷的心不自觉偏向赵小丫，想提点几句，但一看到她的神情就知道，做主的是周屹天，就算她想挪位，还得周屹天点头。
“时侯不早。”夏嬷嬷若有所思的站起身，盘算着找机会向X提一句，“老奴让人备膳。”
天上飘下白雪，站在石碑前的周屹天却浑然未觉，肩上已满是雪花。
周岳和顾良带着护卫站在不远处，无一人敢上前。
赵小丫撑着伞，带着杏儿在一片雪色中走过来。
经过顾良一行人时，她将他们担忧的神色尽收眼底，对他们露出一抹笑，可以明显看初他们因为她到来而松了口气。
她让杏儿留在原地，自己走向站在坟前一身素白的周屹天。
雪地之中，只有她身上的玄色大氅成了唯一的色彩。
“下雪了。”赵小丫轻声说道。
周屹天听到她的声音，眉头微皱，转头看她。
她对他讨好一笑，“再不出来走走，骨头都懒了。”
周屹天没说话，只是伸手握住她的手，察觉她手指微凉，眉头皱得越来越深。
“不冷。”赵小丫声音轻柔，看了墓碑一眼，突然动手拔掉腕上的兽牙手串。
周屹天不知所以的看着她突如其来的举动。
她牵起他的手，试图将兽牙手串套到他的手腕上，但他的骨架太大，试了几次无果，忍不住轻笑，“看来得给哥哥重新串条红线才行。”
content_en:
She closed her eyes, trying to cheer up but she felt even more tired. Not only was her situation unhelpful, it would also delay the business.
"I'm fine..." She endured the discomfort in her throat and forced out a hoarse voice, "Go and do your work."
She originally thought he would put her down and leave without looking back, but unexpectedly, not only did he not put her down, but his hand around her waist tightened.
Her heart trembled, and she raised her head to look at him. She saw worry in his eyes, but more vulnerability and fear. She had never seen him cowardly before, and she suddenly had the urge to cry. She put her hand on his and said, "I'm sorry."
He lowered his head and buried it in her neck. His grandfather's death made him discover the fear of loss buried deep in his heart. This fear was his weakness, and he subconsciously wanted to escape.
Zhao Xiaoya became the one he most wanted to stay by his side, but also the one he most wanted to stay away from.
He was really afraid. When he saw her lying motionless in the carriage, the fear of losing her gripped his heart.
Zhao Xiaoya felt Zhou Yitian's body trembling slightly, and his warm tears soaked her neck. Her heart felt like being pricked by needles again and again, with a dull pain, and she quietly let him cry silently.
She knew that regardless of past or present life, his vulnerability would only appear in front of her because of his pride.
She didn't know how he had gone through the pain of losing a loved one alone in his previous life, but now she was with him.
Her eyes sparkled with tears, and hope rekindled in her withered heart.
Even if the outcome is destined by God, she will live well for him, without fear.
Chapter 10 Dark Night Attack (2)
Zhou Yitian buried Gu Qiaocheng next to his grandmother's tomb in Zhuangzi on the outskirts of Beijing.
This small Zhuangzi was originally the old residence of the Gu family. Gu Qiaocheng took Zhuangzi as a dowry when his daughter got married and entered the prince's mansion. However, after her death, Zhou Tangyao returned the Gu family's dowry in full.
On the day when Gu Qiaocheng was laid to rest, Zhao Xiaoya was wrapped up tightly, with only a pair of eyes exposed. She leaned against Zhou Yitian and insisted on observing the etiquette.
After she came back, she really started to have a fever, and Zhou Yitian tormented the doctor again. He didn't let her go back until her fever subsided and she felt better.
Zhao Xiaoya looked out the window, it was dark and it seemed like heavy snow was about to fall.
This Zhuangzi occupies a small area, just a three-bedroom house, but it is Gu Qiaocheng's life's work.
Zhao Xiaoya stroked the window lattice gently. The original paint had faded and it no longer looked as fresh as before. However, the window lattice was made of high-quality wood, which showed that Gu Qiaocheng had put a lot of thought into it.
"Girl, you haven't recovered yet, so don't stand in front of the window, lest you get cold." The speaker was Grandma Xia, the steward of Zhuangzi who had brought medicine.
Behind her was a girl about the same age as Zhao Xiaoya, Xing'er, who was her granddaughter.
When her daughter died, her son-in-law was in a hurry to welcome a new man. Grandma Xia couldn't bear to leave the little baby who was still nursing, so she took him back to Zhuangzi and raised the little girl until she was sixteen years old, and they were engaged.
Zhao Xiaoya left the window obediently, sat on the couch, took the medicine from Nanny Xia's hand, and drank it without frowning.
Her health has actually improved a lot, but Zhou Yitian is worried. If he hadn't seen that she really couldn't bear it, he would have let her stay in bed and not get up.
Zhou Yitian's selfishness made everyone in Zhuangzi fix their eyes on Zhao Xiaoya. Zhao Xiaoya was really not used to it.
Aunt Xia looked at her kindly and prepared some candy for her.
Zhao Xiaoya took a piece of candy and stuffed it into her mouth, and couldn't help but smile. She felt like she was living more and more, like a child.
"The girl's complexion looks much better today." Aunt Xia said.
The total number of slaves in Zhuangzi was more than 20, all of whom were old slaves of the Gu family at that time. When Gu Qiaocheng left the capital, he had already confessed that everything in the Gu family belonged to Zhou Yitian, so over the years, the slaves also regarded Zhou Yitian as their master.
"It's all the trouble that Auntie took." Zhao Xiaoya learned from Zhou Yue that Auntie Xia had been working as an errand in the Gu Mansion since she was a child and was trusted by Gu Qiaocheng, so she felt a little closer to her.
"I don't dare, old slave." Looking at Zhao Xiaoya's smile, Grandma Xia couldn't help but raise her lips.
Zhou Yitian committed a crime when he was ten years old, and was sent to Zhuangzi by Zhou Tangyao on the grounds of shutting himself up and thinking about his mistakes. He lived in the Zhuangzi for these years.
He didn't care about Zhuangzi's affairs, he was not young, and the Marquis Mansion didn't mention his marriage. Aunt Xia was an old woman who was anxious, but there was nothing she could do.
Unexpectedly, Zhou Yitian finally brought back a girl with great difficulty, but also brought back Gu Qiaocheng's coffin. She felt so mixed with joy and sorrow that she couldn't sleep well for several days.
She could tell from her behavior that although this girl was gentle and kind-hearted, she was not from a high family background. With her status, she selfishly did not think she was worthy of Zhou Yitian. But as soon as she heard that Gu Qiaocheng was interested in her, her thoughts of being unworthy disappeared.
The master always has an accurate eye for seeing people. If he likes her, she must be a good girl. As for the advancement and retreat of her behavior, she can just learn it slowly.
Aunt Xia glanced at Xing'er behind her. Xing'er immediately stepped forward and put all the account books in her hands on the table.
Zhao Xiaoya couldn't help but raise her eyebrows.
"I told the old slave to give it to the girl for review."
Zhao Xiaoya knew that this meant asking her to take care of the house. Although she was literate, she had never taken care of the house.
She reached out her hand and flipped through it, and found that Aunt Xia was very capable. She managed Zhuangzi very well, and the account book she sent was also clearly written.
If she didn't understand something, she would ask. Aunt Xia explained it carefully without any arrogance.
Zhao Xiaoya was always a quick learner, and Grandma Xia couldn't help but really admire her.
"Girl, take a break." Nanny Xia said to Zhao Xiaoya who was attentive: "This account can't be read in one day."
Only then did Zhao Xiaoya notice that time had passed and heavy snow had fallen outside. She closed her account book.
Xing'er immediately stepped forward to take care of it.
Zhao Xiaoya liked this smart girl very much, and Zhou Yitian wanted her to take Xing'er with her.
She has been waiting on others since she was a child, and she never thought that one day she would be waited on. She wanted to refuse, but when her eyes looked at Zhou Yitian's tired and haggard look, she did not bother him with such trivial matters.
"Girl, there is something I don't know whether to say or not..."
Zhao Xiaoya looked directly at Aunt Xia, smiled slightly and said, "Mom, please tell me."
Aunt Xia hesitated, thinking that this was a child younger than Xing'er, and finally she shook her head, "It's okay, it's just that it's cold. Girls, drink more hot tea, and your health will get better faster."
"Thank you, mama, I know."
Looking at Zhao Xiaoya's innocent look, Aunt Xia felt helpless. Zhao Xiaoya was ill before and was arranged by Zhou Yitian to live in her own room in the main courtyard. Although she felt it was inappropriate, seeing that Zhou Yitian was interested in her, she couldn't say anything.
Nowadays, since people are so good, it is natural for them to move to other places. Rather than caring about Zhou Yitian's reputation, she cares about Zhao Xiaoya. This unknown person has not yet been married. If the relationship is not managed well, Zhao Xiaoya will always suffer.
It seems that Zhou Yitian's attitude is that ethics and education are nothing, but after spending a few days together, Grandma Xia's heart unconsciously tilted towards Zhao Xiaoya, and she wanted to make a few remarks, but as soon as she saw her expression, she knew that it was Zhou Yitian who made the decision. Even if she wanted to move, she would still have to nod her head.
"It's getting late." Aunt Xia stood up thoughtfully, thinking about finding an opportunity to mention to X, "Old slave, let someone prepare a meal."
White snow was falling from the sky, but Zhou Yitian, who was standing in front of the stone monument, was completely unaware that his shoulders were already covered with snowflakes.
Zhou Yue and Gu Liang stood not far away with their guards, no one dared to step forward.
Zhao Xiaoya held an umbrella and walked with Xing'er in the snow.
When passing by Gu Liang and his party, she saw their worried expressions and smiled at them. It was obvious that they were relieved because of her arrival.
She asked Xing'er to stay where she was, and walked towards Zhou Yitian, who was standing in front of the grave, dressed in all white.
In the snow, only the black cloak on her body became the only color.
"It's snowing." Zhao Xiaoya said softly.
Zhou Yitian frowned slightly when he heard her voice and turned to look at her.
She gave him a flattering smile and said, "If you don't go out for a walk, you will become too lazy."
Zhou Yitian didn't say anything, just stretched out his hand to hold her hand. He noticed that her fingers were slightly cold and his brows furrowed deeper and deeper.
"It's not cold." Zhao Xiaoya spoke softly, glanced at the tombstone, and suddenly pulled out the animal tooth bracelet from her wrist.
Zhou Yitian looked at her sudden behavior without knowing why.
She took his hand and tried to put the animal tooth bracelet on his wrist, but his frame was too big and she tried several times to no avail. She couldn't help but chuckle, "It seems that I need to string the red thread on my brother again."
